title: Seaspray Assistive Solutions, Inc.
text:
Seaspray Assistive Solutions, Inc.

notes:
Inbound self-serve signup 2026-03-01: small CSaaS company building smart help center + agent assist.
Initial usage: PoC using hosted API from dev account (public cloud). Low traffic now (~3k msgs/month), plan to scale to 40-60k over 3 months if latency/cost ok.
Primary ask on call 2026-03-03: 'How do we keep cost per conversation under $0.02? Can batching/caching + prompt comp deliver that?'
Cost sensitivity: high. Engineering budget constrained. Wants clear levers: batching window, KV/prefix caching, prompt compression, recommended model sizes and quantized variants (if hosted supports).
Technical constraints: mostly short chat sessions (avg 120 tokens/request), some long-doc search embedding jobs at night. Need per-route budgets and spending caps (monthly).
Security: SOC2 required by a couple of customers; asked about audit logs + retention controls. No VPC/on-prem required — public cloud is fine.
Action items from call: LB to share token-usage audit template; Maya to prepare sample batching config and estimate token savings for current prompt sets; SE to propose 2 cost scenarios (conservative / aggressive).
Customer quote (paraphrase): 'If you can show a predictable $/conv and an easy knob to cap spend, we can go live on hosted API for 1st customers.'
Links provided: pricing deck (drive), sample transcripts (fireflies id above).
Follow-up scheduled: 30-min technical deep-dive w/ Maya 2026-03-15 11:00 PT. Prep: attach current prompt set + 7-day token logs — they agreed to export by 2026-03-12.
Notes from quick audit snapshot: majority of tokens from system prompt + long context in 12% of sessions. Good candidate for prompt compression and prefix caching.
Raised billing question (INF-1293): how credits and monthly cap interact with burst traffic — finance on their side wants concrete examples.
Short-term blocker: procurement needs a line-item cost projection for 50k messages/month to route to CFO.
Preferred next-step phrasing for AE email: 'Attached is a small token-audit template and two recommended batching configs — pick a time and we'll walk through estimated savings.'

blockers:
Need internal budget owner to approve monthly cap
Want cost projection for 50k msgs/month
Clarify retention policy for PII in logs

next_step:
Send token-usage audit template + sample batching config; schedule follow-up call week of 2026-03-15
